dedupe_keys.name: opti tool epa region 1 stormwater management optimization tool

description: Opti-Tool is a spreadsheet-based optimisation tool that helps stormwater managers and engineers find the most cost-effective mix of structural green infrastructure, low impact development and other stormwater controls to meet pollutant and runoff volume reduction targets. It covers watershed-wide planning and site-level analysis for developed land in New England, using regionally calibrated long-term hourly runoff and pollutant time series from 9 major land uses, performance parameters for total phosphorus, total nitrogen, suspended solids and zinc across 11 categories of structural controls, and regional unit costs and maintenance effort; the Excel front end calls EPA's SUSTAIN modules to simulate controls and produce cost versus load reduction trade-off curves. It was developed by EPA Region 1 with Tetra Tech, and a Buzzards Bay watershed case study demonstration was published in December 2016. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): EPA web policy: EPA-produced content is in the public domain unless otherwise specified (software licence not stated separately). Caveats: the defaults are calibrated for New England, although a companion utility lets users build inputs from other climate data, and EPA offers no detailed technical assistance. It supports sizing and optimising green-blue stormwater infrastructure for permit compliance and climate adaptation; a related record is EPA SUSTAIN.
